FIDELIDADE.APOIO: Loyalty card and coupons to bring customers back.

VAZIO.FRASE: Bring customers back with a loyalty card.
VAZIO.APOIO: Every purchase earns stamps. A full card earns a reward. You set it up in a minute.
VAZIO.SEM_PODER: This account has no loyalty card yet. An account admin can create one.

CARTAO.FALTAM: {quantos} to go for the reward | {quantos} to go for the reward

MONTAR.APOIO: Answer the questions. The example shows how a customer card looks.
MONTAR.RESUMO: Example: a {exemplo} purchase earns {ganha}. What is left over does not carry to the next one.
MONTAR.TIPO_CARIMBOS_DICA: Like the paper card. Good for repeat services: car wash, haircut, coffee.
MONTAR.TIPO_PONTOS_DICA: Collects points by amount spent. Good when you sell a bit of everything.
MONTAR.META_PONTOS: How many points for the reward

VALIDADES.MESES: {count} month after earning | {count} months after earning

MONTAR.COMECA_DO_ZERO: Counts purchases from today on. Past purchases do not count.
MONTAR.MUDAR_AVISO: Customers keep the stamps they have. The new rule applies to the next purchases.
MONTAR.SALVAR_NOVO: Create and turn on the card

ERROS.A_CADA: Enter an amount above zero, with no cents.
ERROS.GANHA: Enter how many the customer earns: 1 or more.
ERROS.META: Choose how many stamps for the reward.
ERROS.PREMIO: Write the reward, up to 80 characters.

PRONTO.APOIO: From now on, every closed sale earns {unidade} on its own.
PRONTO.PERGUNTA: Want to let customers know on WhatsApp?
PRONTO.SALDO_TITULO: Send the balance after each purchase
PRONTO.META_TITULO: Let them know when the card is complete
PRONTO.SALDO_EXEMPLO: Hi {nome}! You earned {ganhou} and now have {tem} of {meta}. {faltam} to go for your reward.
PRONTO.META_EXEMPLO: Congrats, {nome}! You collected {meta} and completed the card. Your reward is on us next time.
PRONTO.DICA: The message opens ready in Automations, in another tab, turned off. You check it and turn it on there.
PRONTO.ABERTO: Done: the message opened in another tab. Check it and turn it on there.

PAINEL.VALIDADE: The {unidade} expire {count} month after earned. | The {unidade} expire {count} months after earned.
PAINEL.COM_SALDO: customer on the card | customers on the card
PAINEL.PERTO: is close to the reward | are close to the reward
PAINEL.NINGUEM: No one has earned {unidade} yet. They show up when a sale is closed.
PAINEL.VER_PERTO: See who is close to the reward
PAINEL.PASSO_1: The customer buys and you tap Won on their card, in the CRM.
PAINEL.PASSO_2: They earn {unidade} by the purchase amount, automatically.
PAINEL.PASSO_3: Once complete, their profile shows the Give reward button.
PAINEL.PAUSADO_AVISO: The card is paused: purchases are not earning {unidade}.
PAINEL.PECA_PARA_LIGAR: Ask whoever manages the account to turn it back on.
PAINEL.PAUSAR_TEXTO: Purchases stop earning {unidade} until you turn it back on. Customers keep what they collected.

CUPONS.VAZIO_FRASE: Create a coupon to bring customers back.
CUPONS.VAZIO_APOIO: Each customer gets their own code. You see how many used it and how much it sold.
CUPONS.REGUA: In sales: what these customers bought in the 7 days after using the coupon.
CUPONS.VALE: valid {count} day after received | valid {count} days after received

CONFERIR.TITULO: Did a customer show a coupon?
CONFERIR.APOIO: Type the code to check if it is still valid.

RESULTADO.usado: This coupon was already used on {data}.
RESULTADO.vencido: This coupon expired on {data}. It can no longer be used.
RESULTADO.nao_existe: We could not find this code. Check the letters with the customer.

CONFERIR.USADO_AGORA: Done, coupon marked as used. Give the customer {oferta}.

MONTAR_CUPOM.APOIO: Each customer gets their own code, through Automations.
MONTAR_CUPOM.PREVIA_TEXTO: Hi! We have a gift for you: coupon {codigo} gives {oferta}. Valid until {data}.
MONTAR_CUPOM.PREVIA_DICA: The end of the code is different for each customer.
MONTAR_CUPOM.NOME_DICA: Only you see it. The customer gets the code.
MONTAR_CUPOM.PREFIXO_DICA: Letters and numbers only. Looks like: {codigo}
MONTAR_CUPOM.VALIDADES: {count} day after received | {count} days after received
MONTAR_CUPOM.REGRA_FIXA: Each customer uses their code once. Sending again reuses the same code.

ERROS.PREFIXO: Write the code start, with letters or numbers.

FICHA.PAUSADO: The card is paused. The {unidade} are kept.
FICHA.SEM_SALDO_APOIO: The next purchase of {valor} or more earns the first one.
FICHA.PREMIOS_JUNTOS: Enough for {count} reward. | Enough for {count} rewards.
FICHA.USAR_CUPOM_TEXTO: After that it is no longer valid.
FICHA.PAUSADO_VENCEM: The card is paused. The customer keeps their {unidade}, but they still expire on the usual date.
FICHA.ERRO: I could not show the loyalty card.

DAR_PREMIO.TEXTO: Reward: {premio}. {quantos} leave the card. It is noted that you gave it.

DAR.DICA: Gives stamps as a gift: birthday, referral, review.
DAR.AVISO_COMPRA: Purchases already earn {unidade} on their own. Use this step to give them as a gift: birthday, referral, review.
DAR.EXEMPLO: Example: someone with {antes} ends up with {depois} of {meta}.
DAR.EXEMPLO_COMPLETA: Example: someone with {antes} completes the {meta} card.
DAR.REGRAS: If the card is completed, the profile shows the Give reward button. The {unidade} given here expire like the others.
DAR.SEM_PROGRAMA: Create the loyalty card before using this step.
DAR.ENSAIO_PREVIA: Would give the customer {quantos} as a gift
DAR.ENSAIO_FICA: Would give {quantos}: the customer has {tem} and would have {ficaria} of {meta}
DAR.ENSAIO_COMPLETA: Would give {quantos}: the customer has {tem} and would complete the {meta} card
DAR.ENSAIO_SEM_CARTAO: Nobody would get it: the account has no loyalty card yet.
DAR.ENSAIO_PAUSADO: Nobody would get it: the loyalty card is paused.
DAR.ENSAIO_SEM_CONTATO: Nobody would get it: there is no customer here to give to.

CUPOM.DICA: Sends a code just for that customer, with an expiry.
CUPOM.POR_DADO: Add a coupon or card detail
CUPOM.TEXTO_PADRAO_1: Hi! We have a gift for you: coupon
CUPOM.SEM_CODIGO: The coupon code is missing from the message. In “Add a coupon or card detail”, choose “Coupon code”.
CUPOM.REGRAS: Each customer gets their own code. Anyone who already got it gets the same code.
CUPOM.SEM_CUPOM: Create a coupon before using this step.
CUPOM.TEXTO_DICA: Whatever is in brackets is filled in on sending: the code, the discount and the date go in on their own.
CUPOM.ENSAIO_PREVIA: Would send the coupon with a code only for this customer
CUPOM.ENSAIO_NOVO: Would send the coupon {cupom} with a new code, only for this customer
CUPOM.ENSAIO_MESMO: Would send the coupon {cupom} again, with the same code as before
CUPOM.ENSAIO_SEM_CUPOM: Nothing would be sent: the coupon of this step was deleted.
CUPOM.ENSAIO_PAUSADO: Nothing would be sent: the coupon is paused.
CUPOM.ENSAIO_USADO: Nothing would be sent: this customer already used the coupon.
CUPOM.ENSAIO_VENCIDO: Nothing would be sent: this customer's coupon has expired.
CUPOM.ENSAIO_SEM_CONTATO: Nothing would be sent: there is no customer here to receive it.

JANELA.ROTULO: If the customer has not talked to you in the last 24 hours
JANELA.DICA: In that case, official WhatsApp only lets you send a ready-made message that was already approved. Choose which one goes instead of the message above. Each ready-made message sent has a cost.
JANELA.NENHUM: Do not send the coupon to this customer
JANELA.SEM_MODELOS: You do not have an approved ready-made message on official WhatsApp yet. Create one in Templates.
JANELA.SUMIU: The ready-made message {nome} is no longer approved. Choose another one.

GATILHO.NOME: When the loyalty card is completed
GATILHO.DICA: Starts when the customer collects what the card needs for the reward.

VALORES.SALDO: Stamps or points the person has
VALORES.FALTAM: How many to go for the reward

PAGINA.ERRO_SALVAR: Could not save the card. Check the rules and try again.
PAGINA.LIGADO: Done, the card is on again.

PAGINA.CUPOM_CRIADO: Done, the coupon was created. Now just send it.
PAGINA.ERRO_SALVAR_CUPOM: Could not create the coupon. Check the fields and try again.
PAGINA.CUPOM_PAUSADO: Done, the coupon is paused. Whoever already got it can still use it.
PAGINA.CUPOM_LIGADO: Done, the coupon is valid again.
PAGINA.ERRO_LIGAR_CUPOM: Could not change the coupon now. Try again.
PAGINA.ERRO_CONFERIR: Could not check the code now. Try again.
PAGINA.CUPOM_VENCEU: This coupon has expired. It can no longer be used.
PAGINA.ERRO_USAR: Could not mark the coupon now. Try again.

FICHA_ACOES.PREMIO_DADO: Done, the reward for {nome} was recorded.
FICHA_ACOES.ERRO_PREMIO: Could not give the reward right now. Try again.
FICHA_ACOES.SEM_SALDO: The card is not complete yet. Check the balance.
FICHA_ACOES.ERRO_HISTORICO: Could not bring the history right now. Try again.
FICHA_ACOES.CUPOM_USADO: Done, coupon {codigo} was marked as used.
FICHA_ACOES.CUPOM_VENCEU: This coupon has expired. It can no longer be used.
